criteria: One example per category of the project's definition. Phishing: credential-style, scam/fraud, bulk ad. Legitimate: work, personal, mailing list or newsletter.
Readable emails of 250-1200 characters, picked by hand from fewshot_candidates(train_df) in src/llm_classifier.py.
Each class has the same source mix (2 Enron + 1 SpamAssassin), so lowercase (Enron) vs. original case (SpamAssassin) text can't predict the label.
The credential (21659) and scam (25535) examples resemble the Nazario and Nigerian test categories but come from train.csv only.
